canonical_term: Lincoln Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. County Board
summary: Nebraska case authority discussing substantial compliance with equalization and uniformity where designed or manifest departures from rules are avoided.
plain_language: Nebraska courts recognize that assessment is approximate, but intentional or major departures from equalization rules can matter.

relationships.note: Case involved tangible personal property comparison.

source_refs.citation: Lincoln Tel. & Tel. Co. v. County Board, Nebraska Supreme Court text via Justia.
